spots.name: Kvartershistoria
spots.blurb: You've reached Kvartershistoria, a mural by Sven Ljungberg from 1982. It shows genre. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Öxnehaga Väggmålning
spots.blurb: You've reached Öxnehaga Väggmålning, a mural by Paul Kuniholm. Commissioned by Jönköpings Lan regional government, a community mural to assuage criminal activity.  Most wanted posters were the inspiration for animals names spelling Öxnehaga.
